draft.subject: your dispatcher opening
draft.body:
Hi Luis,

Great to meet you at the Midwest Freight Expo last month. Since then I noticed Cobalt Ridge is hiring a dispatcher to take load requests by email and enter each one into your TMS.

We built a citizen-services digital transformation platform with workflow automation and dashboards.

Worth a look?

claims.text: Great to meet you at the Midwest Freight Expo last month
Cobalt Ridge is hiring a dispatcher to take load requests by email and enter each one into your TMS
We built a citizen-services digital transformation platform with workflow automation and dashboards

evidence.text: Dispatcher (days). Take load requests by phone and email, build routes and enter each load into our TMS.

facts.wording: Built a single operations platform covering CRM, orders, inventory, vendors and analytics for an automotive retail and services business (Wish Wheels).
Built a citizen-services digital transformation platform with workflow automation and dashboards (MP Online Digital).
A 17+ person team of engineers, AI specialists and analysts, based in San Jose.
